note: What the developer fee pays for, shown on /burnticker/fees/ledger next to the fee wallet's on-chain income. An amount of null is a placeholder the owner has not given yet (marked as such on the page, never as zero); docs/burnticker/TODO-OWNER.md lists them. Amounts are what the operator pays, in US dollars; nothing here is income.
whatTheFeePaysFor: The developer fee is 25 bps of curve volume (PlatformConfig.feeRate, read live on the trust page). It pays for the attesters, the hosting and RPC that run the keeper and these pages, the security reviews and the bounty, and the operator. It never buys any coin, including the platform's own.
